info.title: Universal Commerce Platform API
info.description: Frontend API for the complete Universal Commerce platform: multi-store connections, ingestion, all finalized Supabase application tables, Bronze/Silver/Gold data, RAG/AI analytics and dashboard specifications. Backend credentials are supplied through environment variables.

get.description: Liveness: the server process is up. Never touches the database.
Readiness: the database is reachable. 503 when it is not configured or down.

post.description: Send a question and get the AI answer in one call (both messages are saved).
Same as ``POST /{id}/messages`` but delivered as Server-Sent Events.

get.description:
Suggested starter prompts for the chat screen.

Without ``tenant_id`` every general prompt is returned. With ``tenant_id``
the list is tailored to the workspace (e.g. "compare my stores" only shows
when 2+ stores are connected) and ``context`` says what is connected, so the
UI can show a "connect a store first" hint when ``connections`` is 0.
Short alias of ``GET /subscription/usage``.

ConversationMessageCreate.title: ConversationMessageCreate
ConversationMessageCreate.description:
Body for POST /conversations/{id}/messages and /conversations/{id}/stream.

There is deliberately no ``role`` field: the server always stores the sender
as ``user`` and the AI reply as ``assistant``, so a client cannot forge an
assistant message.
